subject: Next step: 60-90m ML / infra playbook session — availability & agenda
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Kate Chen <kate@averyrobotics.com>
Cc: Tom Saunders <tom.s@averyrobotics.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Apr 2024 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Next step: 60-90m ML / infra playbook session — availability & agenda

Hi Kate — thanks again for the chat earlier. Quick recap and proposed next step: you mentioned productionizing a customer-facing summarization pipeline (low latency, multitenant, PII controls) and wanting a runway for a Q3 pilot. To make progress I recommend a 60–90 minute technical playbook session with our ML infra and ops leads to: 

- Walk through your current inference topology and constraints (models, sequence lengths, traffic profile)
- Outline deployment options (Hosted API vs Dedicated vs Private) and tradeoffs for latency/cost
- Share a draft runbook for KV caching, batching, and fallback policies
- Clarify security/compliance needs and evidence you need (SOC2, audit logs)

Proposed windows (PST):
- Tue Apr 23, 9:30–11:00am
- Wed Apr 24, 1:00–2:30pm
- Thu Apr 25, 11:00–12:30pm

If none of those work, send two slots that suit your team and we’ll do our best to accommodate. Two asks before the session: 1) a short diagram of your current inference flow (even a screenshot is fine) and 2) who will attend from your side (ML engineer, infra/ops, security). I’ve attached a one-page prep doc and a mutual action plan template to speed alignment.

Looping in Jordan Blake (ops lead) and Monica Patel (solutions engineer) so they can pick the right runbook fragments for your use case.

Thanks — happy to be flexible on timing.

— Marcus
Marcus Lin | Sr. Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0142

Attachments:
- redwood-tdx-precall.pdf (1 page — prep checklist)
- AVR-mutual-action-plan.xlsx (template)

Thanks Marcus — this is exactly what we were hoping to do next. Quick answers:

- Attendees from our side: me (product), Tom (ML lead), and Sanaa Patel (platform/infra). Sanaa may join remotely from Bangalore.
- We can share a high-level architecture doc; I’ll drop that into your HubSpot record today.

Availability works best for us on Wed Apr 24 1:00–2:30pm PST. That time is ideal across product + ML.

One flag: our security team will likely request a short questionnaire and an NDA for some internal docs. Do you have a preferred process? If you can share SOC2 evidence and a light questionnaire, we can start the vendor intake in parallel.

— Kate

Perfect — Wed Apr 24 1:00–2:30pm PST is locked on our side. I’ve created a provisional calendar invite and added Jordan + Monica.

For NDA: we generally use a mutual NDA (DocuSign link below) but if your legal prefers, we can accept the countersigned version you send.

Prep & logistics:
- Confirmed slot: Wed Apr 24, 1:00–2:30pm PST (90 minutes)
- Redwood attendees: Marcus Lin (SE), Jordan Blake (Ops Lead), Monica Patel (Solutions Engineer)
- Avery attendees (as listed by Kate)
- Pre-read: architecture diagram + any representative logs / latency histograms
- Goal: produce a one-page deployment recommendation and an updated mutual action plan (attached template)

DocuSign / links:
- Mutual NDA (optional): https://docusign.redwood.com/ndr/AVR-001
- Calendar invite (provisional): https://calendar.redwood.com/marcus/90min-slot
- HubSpot opportunity: https://hubspot.redwood.com/contacts/AVR-12345

Jordan & Monica — can you confirm you’re available and if you want any additional agenda items?

Thanks — I’ll send the invite after I hear back.

— Marcus

All good on my side — Wed 24th 1:00–2:30pm PST works. I’ll plan to cover capacity planning (GPU pool sizing, autoscale thresholds) and fallback routing (model variants + cold-start behavior). Monica — can you take the security questionnaire and SOC2 package? I’ll prepare a short slide with suggested sizing for a pilot (QPS estimates + cost ballpark).

Kate — if you can drop the architecture diagram into the HubSpot link Marcus shared, that’ll help us target the runbook. Also I proposed a couple additional agenda items:

- Estimated token budget and cost breakdown examples for low/medium/high traffic scenarios
- Data residency & logging retention choices and their operational tradeoffs

Happy to iterate agenda before the call — Marcus, feel free to nudge if you want me to prepare anything else.

— Jordan
